adversarialIntent: Place unique principal-only canaries in rows and failure paths so any channel routing mistake is observable in instrumented host context.

expansion.selection: One nextU32 per dimension in listed order; select values[word % values.length].

checks: No principal-only canary appears in model tool results or model context under any outcome.
